additional_info.subject: ID0442579-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/P0 312569868/02] Charger showing several error CRM:00315002899
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, we have 3 errors here, one with MainFan, one with
MCBs_FC18_FC20_FC20_FC21
and lastly Converter missing.
Please check if FC20 is tripped, if yes, then that is the reason why Mainfan is not working. If after untripping it works, let's leave it and see if it reoccurs. If yes, then please replace the mainfan as it might be doing a short circuit.
For the converter please check if swapping with the neighbour fixes the problem. If not, please replace the converter.
